question: Which among the following will host the International Cricket Council (ICC) Women's T20 World Cup 2024?
solution:
The answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 2024 ICC Women's T20 World Cup will be hosted by Bangladesh.**
 
• The tournament** is scheduled to take place between September and October 2024.**
 
• This will be the **second time that Bangladesh has hosted the ICC Women's T20 World Cup, having previously done so in 2014.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] Mistake Points__**

__
 
• ** The ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 will be played in the West Indies and USA from 1-29 June 2024.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **The ICC Women's T20 World Cup is an international championship of Twenty20 International cricket for women.**
 
• It is **organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC), the governing body of international cricket.**
 
• The inaugural tournament took place in **England in 2009, coinciding with the men's T20 World Cup.**
 
• The tournament was** initially held every two years,** but from 2020 onwards, **it is held every year except for the years when the Women's Cricket World Cup (50-over format) is scheduled.**
 
• The format of the tournament** usually involves a round-robin group stage followed by knockout stages, leading to a final match to determine the world champion.**
 
• **Australia has been the most successful team in the tournament's history, with multiple championship titles to their name.**
 
• The **ICC Women's T20 World Cup** is a** major global event in women's cricket and plays a significant role** in promoting and developing women's cricket worldwide.
 
• It provides an** international platform for female cricketers and has substantially increased the visibility and popularity of women's cricket.**
